notes.title: About the upcoming discount and updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386716/dd8c1cf18978e234ab999bf3080fbd8f98d8c250.jpg[/img]

Greetings,

We are the new publisher of <MONOBOT>, AOEPULS. Moving forward, we will be accompanying you through this magical journey. The moment we came to know <MONOBOT>, we were deeply fascinated by it. The visual and audio experiences are impressive and the in-game content is amazing.
Throughout our time here with <MONOBOT>, we have interacted with many players. Your suggestion and feedback have been constructive and helped us make adjustments to the game.

Updates:
1. Players can now cycle through the user interface button list.
2. Improved the visual effects for two MOD skills (they can now display their respective cooldown).
3. Players can now switch their selected target while using the arm skills.
4. Fixed some minor bugs.

Another good news is that we have also introduced a two-weeks discount for players to enjoy.
Pacific Time: 17:00, August 9th, 2021
Limited-time discount: 38% off

Lastly, thank you for supporting this game.

DreamSmith Studio & AOEPLUS

notes.title: Mono is getting some upgrades and fixes!
notes.content:
Hello! We’ve been working hard to gather feedback and continually improve the game. The community has shared tons of ideas on improvements and places that could use additional focus.

We’ve heard players loud and clear on improvements and have been working on improving certain mechanics and gameplay features.

[list]
[*] Mid-air movement - we’ve broken away from the realistic physics to more of the enjoyable physics players typically find in various games. We’ve given players the ability to control Mono slightly mid-air where he can now turn and move in the selected direction more fluidly.
[*] Arm skill responsiveness - The magnetic arm and the swapping arm skills have gotten an upgrade! Some players felt as the skills weren’t as snappy as they’d like so we’ve tuned them a bit further. Arm skills now respond much more quickly to use and then go into their cool down.
[*] Cranks - Some players were experiencing difficulties with cranks in area 1. We’ve since tuned it a bit to lessen difficulties in crank-related challenges.
[*] And many other smaller bug fixes around save points, respawn, and other smaller features. Feel free to look at the hot fix/patch notes over the last week for more details.
[/list]

Thanks again for everyone that has opened a dialogue up with the team to make the world of Monobot even better. We couldn’t have done this without you. Cheers!

The Ukuza and DreamSmith teams

notes.title: Monobot Launch Trailer & Release Date
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Monobot is officially launching on Steam on [b]June 18, 2021[/b]!

Today we revealed the Monobot launch trailer, which can be seen now on the store page and below, showcasing more parts of the game and digging deeper into Monobot's story. It focuses on Mono's journey and the dangers faced in this world. Can you help him break the cycle?

With us being two weeks away from launch, we couldn't be more excited to share the story of this little bot in a hostile world. We'd love your help to share Monobot with the world! "How can I help" you ask?

[list]
[*] Add Monobot to your Steam Wishlist. ːsteamthumbsupː
[*]Follow Ukuza on [url=https://twitter.com/Ukuza_games/status/1399728844504961026]Twitter[/url]  and comment, like, and share some of the really awesome screenshots, video clips, and concept art we've been sharing
[*]Head over to [url=https://youtu.be/iwILKnnAexs]YouTube[/url] and give the new trailer a thumbs up and a comment
[/list]

The DreamSmith Studio team has lots of surprises in-store for you with puzzles, enemies, and stories in this desolate world of Monobot! We're excited to share it with you. 

Once again, thank you for supporting Monobot on this wild ride!

The Ukuza Team
